result.instructions: Tools for Kourses, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which memberships does my Kourses website sell?"; "Which memberships can member jane@example.com access right now?"; "Give jane@example.com access to membership abcd1234 until 2027-06-30.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kourses data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kourses_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kourses_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kourses_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kourses_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kourses_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List the published memberships of the Kourses website this key belongs to. Each has an id, name, slug and URL. Kourses API: GET /memberships.

tools.name: kourses_list_member_memberships
tools.title: List a member's memberships
tools.description: List the memberships a member can access now (permissions that have not expired). Give the member by id or email. Kourses API: GET /members/{member}/memberships.

tools.name: kourses_create_member
tools.title: Create or update a member
tools.description: Create a member on the Kourses website. If a member with this email already exists, the given fields OVERWRITE the stored ones and the status is 'updated'. Sends an activation email only when send_activation_notification is true (default false here; the API default is true). Kourses API: POST /members.

email.description: Member email address (the member's identity in Kourses).

send_activation_notification.description: Email an activation link to a new member (default false).

tools.name: kourses_grant_membership_access
tools.title: Grant membership access
tools.description: Give a member access to a membership, optionally until a date. No email is sent unless send_notification is true. Repeating a call keeps one permission, but sends the email again when send_notification is true. Kourses API: POST /members/{member}/memberships/{membership}/permissions.

ends_at.description: When the access stops working: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.

skip_drip_schedule.description: Skip the membership's drip schedule (default false).

run_email_integrations.description: Run the membership's email integrations (default false).

send_notification.description: Email the member about the new access (default false).

tools.name: kourses_revoke_membership_access
tools.title: Revoke membership access
tools.description: Remove a member's access to a membership now, or on ends_at when it is given. The member loses the content they paid for; confirm first. Kourses API: DELETE /members/{member}/memberships/{membership}/permissions.

ends_at.description: When the access stops working: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.
